description: A request whose work reaches the relay produces a durable event carrying the SAME Trace-Id: the operation's trace rides the relay's telemetry record and reaches the delivered events/1 envelope unchanged, an entry the relay recorded on its own behalf reaches the envelope carrying the relay's own record-time trace, and a trace the app peer cannot use (malformed, or absent from an older relay) is replaced with a fresh ULID rather than either poisoning the envelope's type or costing the event its delivery.

originating_operation.description: An operator action dispatched from the management door, carrying the Trace-Id api/1 API-060 assigned it.
